4. The two central repairs: routing and complete rectangles


Routing with only one surviving damaged strand

A faulty swap of two live registers can damage both. That is unsafe to combine casually with a factory proved only against one fault.

Instead, interleave a vacant parking slot with every home. On four consecutive slots initially containing
$(A,x,B,y),$
perform
$(0\,1),\quad(2\,0),\quad(1\,3),\quad(3\,2),$
where each pair denotes a SWAP. The result is
$(B,y,A,x).$
Every step exchanges one live carrier with one vacancy, and its range is at most two slots.

For arbitrary $\rho_{AVR}$,
$\operatorname{Tr}_{A}\!\left[
\mathrm{SWAP}_{AV}\rho_{AVR}\mathrm{SWAP}_{AV}^{\dagger}
\right]
=\rho_{AR},$
with the live output relabelled to $V$.

Thus a good move works even when the vacancy is mixed, corrupted or correlated. A bad move affects one surviving live strand plus the vacancy environment. Good later moves do not transfer the vacancy state into a second live strand.

Every MOVE remains a separate child location at every concatenation level. Parking belongs in the recursive space multiplier. Vacated-slot resets, routing colors and all resulting idles are counted.

The finite template compiler restores home ordering. At each substitution level, bounded-span routing windows are colored with a fixed number of colors, producing another bounded-range circuit. The introduced waits are child idles and are protected by the subsequent recursive substitution.


Two leading correction passes

Each computational rectangle is
$\boxed{\mathrm{EC}_1\ ;\ \mathrm{EC}_2\ ;\ G.}$
The passes have independent fresh work. Syndrome and decoder calculations are private to each corrected output coordinate. Complete fresh syndrome copies are serialized, and the copies are computed before their corresponding corrections.

The incoming-error argument is essential. Start with at most $32$ erroneous coordinates per block and one new fault. Expand errors in an operator basis; this does not assume a Pauli noise law.

The retained correction propagation construction bounds directly disturbed data positions by a set $B$ of size at most four. Wrong private decisions, including a syndrome copy straddling a data change, can affect only their assigned targets; conservatively collect at most four such positions in $J$.
